title: Replanning a cutover so a rollback could be retried
problem: A customer's Jira merger had one out-of-hours production window. Looking at the timings, it left no room to roll back and try again if something failed.
approach: I split the work into two windows, added rollback dry runs and pre-cutover checks, and ran Go/No-Go decisions with the customer before each one.
result: Both production windows completed with zero recorded rollbacks.
lesson: A rollback plan only counts if you have rehearsed it and left time to use it.
